contract.intent: Add an ann sessions read: list the archived journeys of this project, each with a per-session goal/status/verdict/legs summary, so archived sessions are discoverable (not only reachable via ANN_STORE once the path is known).
acceptanceCriteria: ann sessions lists the active project archived sessions (.ann/archive/sessions/*) with a per-session summary derived through a read-only Store over that session
Each row shows session, goal leg, status, verdict (met vs done-unconfirmed) and leg count, plus the ANN_STORE pointer
--json supported; project-scoped and read-only; suite green and ann check/verify clean on the live journey
